name: Offline Observer
description: Monitors batch jobs and historical data for anomalies, drift, or SLA misses by replaying or scanning offline stores on a schedule. Complements Online Observer by catching issues only visible across long time windows.
when_to_use: Drift or seasonality requires multi-day windows
Backfill quality must be verified post-hoc
benefits: Cheap to run on schedule (not on hot path)
Easier to debug than online signals
drawbacks: May overlap with online observer — needs dedup
